content: Block bootstrap pitfalls: high sensitivity to block-length choice - too short fails to capture autocorrelation/vol clustering (understates true variance, CIs too tight), too long leaves too few effective blocks (poor distributional approximation, CIs erratic); no universally optimal length exists, so a block-length sensitivity check (report results at 2-3 block lengths) is standard due diligence, not optional polish, before the block length is frozen in Gate 2.
